text: Brief IntroductionThis program is designed to meet the needs of those who wish to understand China’s economy. The courses are intended to equip students with the main tools of the professional economist, whether they intend to work in government, international organizations or business. The structure of the program is flexible and allows students to specialize to some extent in either economic theory or China’s economy. The program provides an introduction to the study of Chinese economy, drawing on a range of aspects including industrial structure, financial market, trade policy, etc. The course not only prepares students for research work in an academic discipline but also is suitable for those with career interests related to China.Duration The two-year master’s program will be fully taught in English. Upon the completion of the program, graduates will earn a Master Degree of Economics, recognized by the Ministry of Education of the People’s Republic of China.CoursesClick here to download the curriculumCredit RequirementsThe total credits required for the program are 35.Master’s ThesisIn the second year, the students must finish their master’s thesis of no less than 30,000 words. The thesis should be submitted on time and defended during the fourth term (In mid-May).Degree AwardedMaster of Economics.
